items.text:
"Hiding in plane sight" (or "plain sight") combined with a "24/7/365 livestream" generally refers to live aviation webcam feeds.
Because the phrase can match a few different online streams or media properties, here is how you can find exactly what you are looking for:
1. 24/7 Airport & Plane Spotting Livestreams
If you are looking for real-time video feeds dedicated to watching airplanes land, take off, and taxi around-the-clock, several dedicated platforms offer global coverage:
Airline Videos Live: This network broadcasts continuous aviation streams and features a 24/7 LAX Multi-Angle Feed utilizing hotel cameras overlooking Los Angeles International Airport. 
Facebook
YouTube Live Channels: Communities like LA Flights and Big Jet TV host massive online plane-spotting watch groups. You can pair these livestreams with tracking platforms like Flightradar24 to look up exact aircraft specs as they appear on screen. 
Facebook
2. Other Media Titled "Hiding in Plain Sight"
If you are tracking down a continuous broadcast or video loop for a specific documentary or series, it likely points to one of these major titles:
Youth Mental Health Documentary: Ken Burns Presents: Hiding in Plain Sight, a highly regarded public television documentary focusing on youth mental illness. The full film and dedicated clips are actively hosted on the PBS Well Beings Video Collection. 
Instagram
 +2
Independent Media Channel: The Hiding In Plain Sight YouTube Channel features short documentaries uncovering forgotten history, local lore, and hidden architecture, though they do not broadcast a standard 24/7 live video stream. 
YouTube
Reality TV & Gaming: If you are thinking of a strategic social game where contestants attempt to evade detection, check out the Million Dollar Secret Series on Netflix, or search the Twitch Hidden in Plain Sight Directory to see if anyone is currently streaming the indie video game of the same name. 
Twitch
